programme.title: Golmaal Again
programme.desc: A group of friends returns to an orphanage and encounters a friendly ghost. Hilarity meets heart as they uncover hidden secrets in this supernatural comedy full of nostalgia and fun.

programme.title: Love Sonia
programme.desc: When Sonia's debt-ridden father sells her sister, she sets out on a journey hoping to rescue her. Sonia's life takes an unusual turn when she gets trapped in the world of flesh trade.

programme.title: Dil Bechara
programme.desc: A love story involving two cancer patients, starring Sushant Singh Rajput and Sanjana Sanghi. Based on the novel The Fault in Our Stars' by John Green.

programme.title: Betaab
programme.desc: Sunny Deol and his childhood friend Roma Amrita Singh fall in love with each other. But Roma's father Shammi Kapoor disapproves of their union and decides to separate them.

programme.title: Dhoom 3
programme.desc: A circus performer turns to crime to avenge his father's humiliation, facing off against a relentless cop. High-octane stunts, emotion, and revenge collide in this stylish action thriller.

programme.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
programme.desc: A psychiatrist unravels strange events in an ancestral mansion haunted by secrets. As science clashes with superstition, a shocking truth emerges in this gripping psychological horror-comedy.

programme.title: Padmaavat
programme.desc: Padmavati is happily married to a Rajput ruler until a tyrant Sultan, Alauddin Khilji, enters their life and calls a war on their kingdom.

programme.title: Andhadhun
programme.desc: An inspiring tale unfolds where faith and destiny collide, testing hearts and guiding souls toward truth, sacrifice, and the eternal light of divine blessings.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

programme.title: Parole
programme.desc: After their mother's untimely demise, two estranged brothers who hate each other must reunite to perform her final rites.

programme.title: Guru
programme.desc: Aditya, a boxer, sees potential in a vegetable vendor, Rameshwari, and decides to train her. However, the two do not get along due to the former's harsh training style and the latter's hostile nature.

programme.title: Saas Bahu Aur Sensex
programme.desc: Binita relocates to Navi Mumbai with her daughter Navya after a divorce. New friendships lead them into the exciting and unpredictable world of stock market investing.

programme.title: Dhoom
programme.desc: A fearless cop and a biker thief engage in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase through high-speed robberies. The stylish action film redefined Bollywood's love for speed, style, and attitude.

programme.title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
programme.desc: Dev and Maya, both unhappy in their marriages, become friends and support each other. While trying to fix their relationships, they unexpectedly fall in love, complicating their lives.

programme.title: Om Shanti Om
programme.desc: A junior artiste in Bollywood films is reborn as a superstar. He exposes the murder of his love, a yesteryears' superstar.

programme.title: Kaabil
programme.desc: This is the story of a blind couple who lived, laughed and loved just like everyone in this world. Until one day, a terrible tragedy struck.

programme.title: Mere Yaar Ki Shaadi Hai
programme.desc: Sanjay and Anjali secretly love each other, but Anjali's engagement to Rohit traps them. They must confront their true feelings before it's too late.

programme.title: Akira
programme.desc: A fearless young woman stands up against a corrupt system after being framed for murder. Armed with courage and combat skills, she fights for justice in a society where power silences truth.

programme.title: Duplicate
programme.desc: A lookalike thief and a simple man's identities get swapped, causing hilarious confusion and danger. Shah Rukh Khan's double role drives this entertaining mix of comedy, romance, and action.

programme.title: Noorie
programme.desc: Yusuf and Noorie are set to get married but after her father's sudden death, the wedding is postponed. While work takes Yusuf out of town, Noorie is left to fend for herself from many evils.

programme.title: Dil Bole Hadippa
programme.desc: A spirited Punjabi girl disguises herself as a man to join a cricket team. Her secret, determination, and romance blend in a lively story celebrating gender equality, passion, and self-belief.

programme.title: Mimi
programme.desc: An aspiring actress in a small town agrees to bear a child for a visiting couple seeking a surrogate mother, but her experience takes unexpected turns.

programme.title: Housefull
programme.desc: A man cursed with bad luck finds himself in a web of misunderstandings and chaos. With wild humor, love triangles, and situational gags, it's a full-blown comedy of errors.

programme.title: Raja Shivaji
programme.desc: A young warrior's dream of forging a sovereign Maratha realm meets ruthless resistance as he defies the overwhelming might of the Adil Shahi Sultanate and the formidable Mughal Empire.

programme.title: Stree 2: Sarkate Ka Aatank
programme.desc: After the events of Stree, the town of Chanderi is being haunted again. This time, women are mysteriously abducted by a terrifying headless entity.

programme.title: Hyderabad Blues
programme.desc: A young NRI returns to India and struggles to adapt to traditional expectations. Through humor and reflection, the film explores identity, culture shock, and rediscovering one's roots.

programme.title: Meri Jaan
programme.desc: On the road to recovering his debts, a young man realizes he is also on his way to falling in love.

programme.title: Ghar
programme.desc: Vikas regains his senses only to he find himself in hospital with a head wound. Aarti too is in the same hospital after being assaulted.

programme.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana
programme.desc: Dharam and his son exist by conning people. Soon Paramveer arrives in town and claims he is Dharam's elder son.

programme.title: Baghban
programme.desc: An elderly couple's love is tested when their grown children abandon them. Their story reflects the emotional struggles of aging parents and the timeless power of love, dignity, and family values.

programme.title: Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania
programme.desc: A carefree boy falls for a bride-to-be, leading to emotional chaos before her wedding. The film captures youthful love, rebellion, and the importance of following one's heart.

programme.title: Munjya
programme.desc: A young man returns to his village, uncovering a family secret and a vengeful spirit named Munjya who desires marriage, bringing unexpected danger and revelations.

programme.title: Loveyapa
programme.desc: A couple swaps phones, leading to chaos. They discover secrets and face harsh truths about each other's hidden lives. The exchange unravels their relationship.

programme.title: Dacoit Ek Prem Katha
programme.desc: Dacoit seeks redemption after falling in love, as his criminal past and his relationship create conflict and difficult choices.

programme.title: Oh Humnava Tum Dena Saath Mera
programme.desc: Aparajita, a talented artist haunted by her past, crosses paths with Rakshit, a reserved businessman. Though he avoids romance, their unexpected connection might just lead to true love.

programme.desc: Reclusive Saumya finds the courage to rebuild her life after meeting Jeet, a free-spirited rebel. Their passionate love story blossoms in the heart of Prayagraj, changing them forever.

programme.desc: Sayali desires a fairytale romance, but fate intertwines her with Sachin, a complex figure. Will her dreams of a perfect life survive this unexpected connection.

programme.desc: Boyne Annesley follows up leads that he hopes will prove what happened to his daughter Chrissie, and meets MP Hannah Bardell to campaign for more Foreign Office support after suspicious deaths.

programme.title: Germanwings: What Happened on Flight 9525?
programme.desc: The circumstances surrounding the crash of an Airbus A320-211 in 2015, which killed 150 people and was found to have been deliberately caused by the co-pilot.

programme.title: Savage Mountain
programme.desc: Documentary following Kristin Harila's rapid rise from relative newcomer to world record-breaking mountaineer when she completed all 14 of the world's highest peaks in just 92 days alongside climbing partner Tenjen Lama Sherpa. However, as their achievement made global headlines, footage from K2 sparked intense controversy, placing Kristin at the centre of a worldwide debate about ambition, ethics and how extreme achievements are portrayed.

programme.title: Everton: Howard's Way
programme.desc: Documentary film telling the story of Everton and how they reached their trophy-winning peak in the 1980s under the stewardship of Howard Kendall.

programme.title: Discovering: Julia Roberts

programme.title: 100 Foot Wave

programme.desc: When the first epic swell of the season leads to chaos in the water and on the cliffs, Nazaré officials announce a surf ban.

programme.title: Spector

programme.title: Forced Out

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen is brought to a secretive underground society following the destruction of the televised deathmatch. She becomes the figurehead of a revolution against the despotic Panem regime, while her friend Peeta remains a captive of its tyrannical president. Part one of the two-part conclusion to the sci-fi adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Julianne Moore and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: The civilisation of Panem is consumed by a bloody civil war. Reluctant rebel leader Katniss Everdeen leads a band of her allies on a mission to end the conflict at one stroke by assassinating the despotic President Snow - but faces many dangers as she closes in on her target. Conclusion of the sci-fi adventure series based on Suzanne Collins' novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman in his final role.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A totalitarian future holds an annual nationally televised event in which two children from each of its regions fight to the death until only one remains. A teenage girl takes her younger sister's place in the games and must pit her wits against the deadly combat skills of her rivals. Sci-fi adventure based on Suzanne Collins' novel, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Woody Harrelson and Elizabeth Banks.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen's victory in a televised death match makes her a focus for revolution against the totalitarian nation she lives in. The rulers of the regime plot to crush dissent with a new series of games, in which past champions battle it out. Sci-fi adventure sequel based on the second book in Suzanne Collins' trilogy of novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Liam Hemsworth, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: A mischievous trio of talking chipmunks invade a struggling songwriter's home. When the furry critters demonstrate a remarkable talent for singing, he agrees to help them find fame and fortune. However, an unscrupulous record company boss has other plans. Children's comedy, starring Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The singing trio are left in the care of their manager's nephew and try to save a school's music programme by winning a battle-of-the-bands competition. However, they encounter fierce rivalry from another group of musical rodents. Comedy, starring Zachary Levi, Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long and Christina Applegate.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: The singing rodents cause mayhem while performing on a tropical cruise, before they find themselves stranded on a desert island. As they search for a way to get back to civilisation, it becomes clear that they are not alone. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Jenny Slate, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley.
